name: semble-verifiable-index-attestations
instr:
Semble cannot prove that every index representation belongs to the same ordered generation. Add durable, deterministic attestations that can be inspected and verified before reuse or retrieval, with component-level corruption and alignment diagnostics.

Canonical evidence must depend only on retrieval semantics: ordered chunks; order-independent manifests; BM25 document order, token counts, lengths and postings; and dense values, shape and numeric type. Handle signed zero, non-finite values and memory layout deterministically. An `IndexAttestation` combines independently inspectable component evidence into one deterministic generation and rejects missing, duplicate or substituted required components.

Keep chunk, manifest, BM25 and dense identities aligned during fresh and incremental construction. Preserve unchanged ranges and replace every trace of changed or removed files. `SembleIndex.save`, `SembleIndex.load_from_disk` and cache acquisition must preserve and verify attestations before treating a generation as valid or reusable. Keep existing compatibility behavior for legacy unattested caches.

Semble exports `ComponentEvidence`, `IndexAttestation`, `VerificationIssue`, `VerificationReport` and `IndexVerificationError`. `verify` and `verify_persisted_index` return deterministic issues without private access. BM25 and dense representations expose `attestation_evidence`. Export `attest_chunks`, `attest_manifest` and `build_attestation` from `semble.attestation`, and `verif
